conviction_note: ROKU is a cash-and-stock merger-arb ($96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA, ~0.65% gross spread at 18:09-18:21 UTC on 2026-11-02, Roku shareholder approval done 2026-10-14, DOJ second request open since 2026-09-08). Roku is giving no call and no outlook, so its own Q3 numbers carry almost no price information. Over the window the stock should move about 0.39x FOXA's 2026-11-03 move, plus a small spread change. I found nothing directional, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to +0.1, a slight lean from a possible FOXA post-earnings drift, and they agree with the scaled number in substance.
bar: No bar. Roku gives no outlook and no call for Q3 2026 because of the pending Fox merger (https://finviz.com/news/404215/roku-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-nov-2, 2026-10-19). I found no sourced Q3 2026 consensus. The last company guide I found (FY2026 platform revenue +18% to $4.89B, Feb 2026) is stale and pre-dates the deal. With no bar, every finding is capped small, and the stock prices the deal, not the quarter.
positioning_check: Short interest 10.4M shares, 3.7 days to cover at FINRA settlement 2026-08-14 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/roku/short-interest/). Equibles shows ~10.6M, 7.2% of float, 4.3 days (https://equibles.com/stocks/roku/shortinterest). No October figure found. In a stock-component deal, arbs typically go long ROKU and short FOXA, so this is not a crowded directional short. Skew: baseline 25d skew is +10.2 vol points (downside paid) with an event-implied move of 3.31%. The chain is thin (total OI 3,133, ATM spread 25.7% of mid), and 20d realised vol is 12.3% annualised (~0.8%/day). So the option numbers overstate the move for a pinned arb. The put bid reads as deal-break insurance, not a statement about the print.

findings.finding: ROKU trades as a pinned merger-arb, not on its print. Deal value is $96.00 cash + 0.9693 FOXA = $157.40 at FOXA $63.35 (18:21 UTC 2026-11-02), against ROKU $156.38 at the seal: a gross spread of ~0.65%. Roku stockholders approved the deal on 2026-10-14. Roku will give no call and no outlook for Q3. So the Q3 numbers can move the stock only through deal-break probability, which a 0.65% spread prices near zero. Over the window ROKU's beta to FOXA is ~0.39 (61.4/156.4).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only print inside the arb regime was 2026-08-06 (Q2, amc), +2.03% per the baseline. The five earlier reactions (-15.06% to +14.14%) pre-date the 2026-06-15 deal and are not a base rate here (sweep: baseline_history_trustworthy false).
findings.why_not_priced: This is the pricing mechanism itself, so it is fully priced. If the market treated the print as informative, the event straddle would be paid by realised vol. Instead, 20d realised vol is 12.3% annualised against a 40.9% ATM IV, and the spread sits under 1%. It is filed so a judge sees that the print has no line to land on.
findings.independence: Roku 8-K on the 2026-10-14 vote, and DOJ second request received 2026-09-08 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001428439/000114036126039632/ef20083760_8k.htm). TIKR, updated 2026-10-26, shows ROKU $159 against the $160 headline, <1% gap (https://www.tikr.com/blog/roku-gains-38-in-six-months-as-foxs-160-offer-meets-doj-scrutiny). No call, no outlook: https://finviz.com/news/404215/roku-to-announce-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-nov-2

findings.finding: Fox reported a record fiscal Q1 2027 before the open on 2026-11-02. Revenue was $4.57B (+22% YoY), adjusted EBITDA $1.64B (+54%) and adjusted EPS $2.54 against $1.51 (World Cup, political ads, Tubi). Yet FOXA was only +0.17% intraday at 13:21 ET ($63.35 against a $63.24 prior close), after falling from $68.27 on 10-22. A day-2 post-earnings re-rating of FOXA would pass into ROKU at ~0.39x through the 0.9693 exchange ratio.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measured: I have no FOXA day-2 post-earnings history in hand. FOXA's daily closes 10-20 to 11-02 moved -1.9% to +3.7% a day, which is ~0.7-1.4% on ROKU at 0.39x.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the release came before the entry close, and FOXA has had a full session to react. The only unpriced part is a possible drift on day 2 after a strong headline that met a flat tape. If the market had fully priced a re-rating, FOXA would have closed well up on the day, which it had not done by 13:21 ET.
findings.independence: FOXA tape from Yahoo chart v8 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/FOXA?range=10d&interval=1d), a different source. This is transmission inference, not a confirmed reaction.

findings.finding: The DOJ second request (received 2026-09-08) is still open, and I found no substantial-compliance or timing-agreement disclosure as of 2026-11-02. Roku's Q3 10-Q, expected with or right after the release, will carry the current HSR status and closing expectation (last stated: first half of 2027). Any change, such as a timing agreement, extended timeline or remedy discussion, would move the spread in the window. My sign is neutral with a fatter downside tail.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the second request was disclosed on 2026-09-08/09, the spread was later quoted at ~2.8% ($4.36 gap, TIKR 2026-09-24). It has since narrowed to ~0.65%, which shows the market has looked through the DOJ review so far.
findings.why_not_priced: A 0.65% gross spread with ~6+ months to an H1-2027 close is below the risk-free carry, so the market prices near-certain approval and no delay. A 10-Q line pointing to a longer timeline or remedies would widen the spread, and the current spread holds no premium for that. I have no document saying such a line is coming, so the size is 0 with the tail kept in the range.
findings.independence: Semafor via Reuters, 2026-09-08: DOJ examining Fox-content favouritism and rival access on the Roku platform (https://ground.news/article/01393356-427e-46d1-bd94-d95662a8ec58). The Roku 8-K of the 2026-10-14 vote restates the second request. All of these rest on the same 2026-09-08 event.

outside_window.finding: Outcome of the DOJ second-request review (clearance, consent decree or challenge). Expected deal close is H1 2027. No decision is dated inside the window.

baseline_tension: The skew pays for downside and the run-up is flat (+1.94% over 20d, 2.3% off the 52w high). Both fit a pinned arb where puts are deal-break insurance. My neutral sign does not fight the skew, and my abs_move (1.0%) is well below the option-implied 3.31% because the chain is thin and realised vol is ~0.8%/day.
